data.title: 角楯花凛 · 奢华套房床榻的依偎温存
data.description: 夜色深沉的高级海景套房里，花凛侧卧在凌乱的丝绸床单上，纯白丝绸睡袍轻拢勾勒出深肤色矫健而性感的极致曲线。她依恋地靠向老师怀中，修长美腿自然交迭，金瞳满溢着毫无保留的信赖与情潮。
data.action: 她依恋地靠向老师怀中，修长美腿自然交迭，金瞳满溢着毫无保留的信赖与情潮
data.lighting: deep romantic moonlight from floor-to-ceiling windows and warm floor lamps
data.promptProse: Inside an upscale oceanview penthouse suite at night, Karin lounges comfortably across tousled silk bedding with her legs gracefully crossed and a soft, trusting gaze illuminated by cool window moonlight and a warm floor lamp.
data.animaCaption: Reclining sideways across the rumpled penthouse silk sheets with her long bare legs crossed, she wears a loosely sashed pure white silk kimono bathrobe slipping off her shoulders and gazes warmly toward the viewer in blended moonlight and floor-lamp glow.
data.nsfwProse: Her flowing pure white silk kimono bathrobe is tied loosely at the waist, parting gently off her bare shoulders, collarbones, and bare legs.
